selection_method: Screened top 500 ranked unannotated functions locally; retained functions with exact NSO guest-address-resolved strings, at least one indexed caller, and <=300 body lines. Built 90-line evidence excerpts and balanced ten worker packets by body/evidence cost.
notes: All 18 proposed names were independently checked; 17 confirmed and one normalized to project snake_case.
The remaining 21 targets were kept unnamed; 14 blanks received independent samples and 7 were conservative automatic carry-through.
No token meter was available, so model usage savings cannot be quantified.
Compared with Wave100, this batch had a higher proposal acceptance ratio (18/39 vs. 13/50); throughput is not directly comparable because the target filter and body sizes differed.
